changelog:
- Initial release of fsxmemory: a structured memory system for AI agents.
- Features context death resilience (checkpoint/recover), structured storage, and Obsidian-compatible markdown.
- Supports local semantic and keyword search (via qmd integration).
- Enables easy vault initialization, memory storage by type, quick capture, and migration from OpenClaw/Obsidian vaults with backup/rollback.
- Includes auto-linking, structured templates, and best-practice workflows for context continuity and knowledge organization.
summary: Structured memory system for AI agents. Context death resilience (checkpoint/recover), structured storage, Obsidian-compatible markdown, and local semantic search.
